claim.excerpt: Only one (fatal) case of tramadol poisoning presenting with hypoglycaemia and cardiac arrest has previously been reported with a plasma concentration of 5.2 mg/L.

sources.title: An unconscious man with profound drug-induced hypoglycaemia

why_it_matters: Concentration values are often misread as thresholds; the reviewer must confirm specimen, population, statistic and that the value is reported in context only.
limitations: Value is cited from an earlier report, not measured by the citing authors.
Whether the plasma sample was taken before or after death is not stated in the excerpt.

concentration_context.case_type: tramadol poisoning with hypoglycaemia and cardiac arrest (fatal outcome)
limitations: Value is cited from an earlier report, not measured by the citing authors.

reviewer_checklist: Excerpt matches the source at the stated location.
Proposed value says no more than the excerpt.
Source is current (not retracted/superseded) and the licence allows this use.
Context and limitations are complete; nothing is presented as a threshold.
